newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's polished diamond exports rise in July.
newsitem.headline: Israel's polished diamond exports rise in July.

text.p: Israel's net exports of polished diamonds in July totalled $505 million, up 17 percent from $431 a year earlier, the Ministry of Industry and Trade said on Sunday.
In January-July net exports of polished diamonds rose nine percent to 2,597 million from $2,388 million last year.
Net exports of uncut diamonds totalled $99 million in July. Since the beginning of the year exports of uncut diamonds totalled $624 million, a rise of 48 percent from last year.

Total diamond exports, polished and uncut, rose 18 percent in July, up to $604 million from $510 million last year. Israel exported $3,221 million worth of uncut and polished diamonds in January-July, against exports of $2,809 million in the same period last year, a rise of 15 percent.
The main export markets continued to be the United States, Hong Kong, Japan, Belgium and Switzerland.

Israel's supervisor of diamonds said in a statement the high July exports were due to manufacturers transferring goods to their marketing destinations before the Israeli diamond bourse closed in August for the summer holiday.
